notes.knownDefect: forma2 0.1.22 fails every bulk upload that has to write a contact: the raw upsert passes the attribute data types as an array literal to the ContactAttributeDataType enum column (PostgreSQL 22P02 `invalid input value for enum "ContactAttributeDataType": "{"string"}"`), so the route answers 500. The code at 3db326f is unchanged. The intended behaviour is 200 `{"data": {"status": "success", "message": "Contacts bulk upload successful"}}`.
